Typography

Headings, text, lists, quotes and code in the theme: 14px text, semibold headings, neutral grays.

Headings

Heading 1 28px

Heading 2 24px

Heading 3 21px

Heading 4 19px

Heading 5 18px, headings of pages and boxes
Heading 6 14px

Display

Display 6

A lead paragraph stands out from the text around it, for an introduction of a page.

A normal paragraph of 14px with 20px lines. It has a link, bold and italic text, a highlight, small text, deleted and inserted text and an abbreviation HTML.

Secondary text for less important information, e.g. a description under a heading.
